seo.meta_description: Full Texas Roadhouse menu with prices and calories for 2026. Hand-cut steaks, ribs, combos, chicken, seafood, sides, kids meals and desserts, with value tips.

price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and may vary by location, portion and current promotions. Last updated October 2026.

hero_image.alt: Grilled steak dinner with corn, tomato and rosemary on a plate

intro: Texas Roadhouse is built around one simple idea: hand-cut steaks at a price most steakhouses cannot match, served in a loud, busy room with free peanuts and warm rolls. Every steak and main course comes with your choice of two sides, so the number you see on the menu is close to the number you actually pay. That is why the bill here usually lands lower than a sit-down steakhouse of the same size. Below is the full Texas Roadhouse menu with prices and calories for 2026, broken down by category, with the value picks worth knowing before you order.
quick_answer: A 6 oz hand-cut sirloin is around $13.99 and comes with two sides. The cheapest steak is the Road Kill chopped steak at about $12.49. The famous Cactus Blossom appetizer is around $7.99 (and a shareable 2,250 calories). Kids meals start at $4.99, and the fresh-baked rolls with cinnamon butter are free with every meal.
hot_deal: Early Dine specials: at most locations you can get several full dinners, each with two sides, at a lower price when you eat early (usually before 6pm, Monday to Thursday). Exact dishes, prices and times vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest steak at Texas Roadhouse?
faqs.a: The Road Kill chopped steak is the lowest-priced steak at around $12.49, followed by the 6 oz Hand-Cut Sirloin at about $13.99. Both come with your choice of two sides.

faqs.q: Do Texas Roadhouse steaks come with sides?
faqs.a: Yes. Every steak and entree comes with your choice of two made-from-scratch sides, plus free fresh-baked rolls with cinnamon butter and free roasted peanuts.

faqs.q: How many calories is the Cactus Blossom?
faqs.a: The full Cactus Blossom appetizer is around 2,250 calories, which is why it is meant to be shared by the table. With the dipping sauce it goes higher.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Texas Roadhouse?
faqs.a: The best known are the Cactus Blossom, the hand-cut sirloin, the Bone-In Ribeye, the fall-off-the-bone ribs, and the Rattlesnake Bites appetizer.

faqs.q: Does Texas Roadhouse have an early dinner deal?
faqs.a: Yes. Most locations run Early Dine specials with several discounted full dinners, usually before 6pm Monday to Thursday. The dishes, prices and times vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Texas Roadhouse offer any discounts?
faqs.a: Yes. The free VIP Club gives you coupons and a birthday reward. Military veterans and first responders get 10% off year-round, and veterans often get a free meal on Veterans Day. There is no senior discount.

faqs.q: Does Texas Roadhouse have a lunch menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Many locations offer lunch specials and smaller lunch portions at lower prices during weekday lunch hours.
